verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json, an API reference bundled into agent prompts, and a no-code Playground for transcribing audio. None of these documents an interactive API reference with runnable, try-it-in-place examples: the Playground is an adjacent feature and the OpenAPI file is a developer building block, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
